settings.heading: Track your order
settings.text: Your tracking link is in your shipping confirmation email. You can also log in to see your order status anytime.

settings.title: Order placed
settings.text: You'll get an order confirmation email right away.

settings.title: Ships in 1–3 business days
settings.text: We email your tracking number as soon as it ships. Tracking can take 2–3 days to update.

settings.question: I can't find my tracking number
settings.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder for an email from Kindhand. Still nothing? Email support@kindhandco.com with your order number.

settings.question: My tracking hasn't updated
settings.answer: Tracking can take 2–3 business days to show its first update. If it hasn't moved for 10 business days, email us and we'll look into it.

settings.question: My package seems lost
settings.answer: If it hasn't arrived within 25 business days of shipping, email us. We'll send a free replacement or a full refund.

settings.heading: Common questions
settings.subheading: Still stuck? We reply within one business day.
